extDescription.message: Open start.gg, Hivee, Challonge and Tonamel tournaments in Smash Ranker's tournament page and graphic tools.

buttonOpen.description: The floating button's main part, on a page the site has a tournament page for.

buttonTools.description: The floating button on a page with no tournament page (Challonge, Tonamel): it opens the menu.

buttonMore.description: Label of the button's arrow, which opens the menu.

menuHideHint.message: Turn it back on from the Smash Ranker icon in the toolbar.

needsEvent.message: Open one of the tournament's events to load it into a tool.

toolResultsDesc.message: A player's run, set by set

toolPredictDesc.message: Predict the placements and share them

popupThisTournament.description: Shown when the page's title gives no tournament name.

popupNoPage.message: Open a tournament on start.gg, Hivee, Challonge or Tonamel to load it into a tool from here.

popupShowButton.message: Show the button on tournament pages
